guidance_for_write_dockerfile_agent: The docker build fails at the step where it attempts to download and install Mambaforge using wget from the URLs: https://github.com/conda-forge/miniforge/releases/latest/download/Mambaforge-Linux-x86_64.sh and https://github.com/conda-forge/miniforge/releases/download/23.7.2-0/Mambaforge-Linux-x86_64.sh. Both URLs return 404 Not Found errors, indicating these URLs are outdated or incorrect. You need to update the Dockerfile to use a valid and existing download URL for the Mambaforge installer. To fix this, visit the official Miniforge/Mambaforge GitHub releases page (https://github.com/conda-forge/miniforge/releases/) to find the latest stable Mambaforge Linux x86_64 installer URL, and replace the current wget command with the correct link. Avoid using a fallback wget command with a hard-coded version likely outdated. This fix is necessary because without the Mambaforge installation, the conda environment setup and all subsequent steps fail, preventing the tests from ever running.
